topic.title: Average Height with Built-ins
topic.description: Calculates the average height of a list of students using Python built-in functions sum() and len(). Demonstrates the power of built-in functions for clean code.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Using sum() and len() together to compute an average in a single readable expression.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Compare with a manual loop approach for deeper understanding.
